player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Crusher''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech in August 2000.

starting.card: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place

description: a BHBM crap deck that can win if you play it well
cards: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Total 60 as published; section counts match (headers 'starting8', 'location4', 'bad guys15', 'blue10', 'green1', 'red22' are section headers, not cards).

Starting section: the Objective, Death Star II: Throne Room, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, 'the 3 effect card' (Prepared Defenses, the starting Interrupt that fetches three Effects), Oppressive Enforcement, Imperial Arrest Order and Mobilization Points; several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.
Posted 'db' (a fourth docking bay, not named; likely Executor: Docking Bay or Spaceport Docking Bay) is UNKNOWN; 'grabbler x2' is UNKNOWN (no named card).

Posted 'choke vader' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'scoobi doo(sim aloo)' Sim Aloo; 'the other concelor' Janus Greejatus (the Emperor's other advisor); 'cabel' Lieutenant Cabbel; 'sarkil' Captain Sarkli; 'ig88 w stick' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'suckass in boat' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'the new executor' Flagship Executor (Death Star II); 'dreadnut' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'tempest 6' Tempest Scout 6; 'mara stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'masta move' Masterful Move; Oppressive Enforcement is the older Effect (no Defensive Shields in 2000).
The strategy contains profanity aimed at readers; posted text kept as published.
player_note: Posted as 'GenCon winner DS deck' (15 August 2000); the description calls it 'a BHBM crap deck that can win if you play it well' and the strategy says 'THIS DECK = SHIT I GOT A BETTER VERSION NOW BUT IT WILL BE KEEP SECRET'. Lapointe won the 2000 North American Continental Championship (GenCon, 11–13 August 2000); the post gives no record.
